faqs: Can the itinerary be tailored to our interests?
Yes. Tell us what you enjoy, how you like to travel and how much time you have. We will propose a route and service scope for your review.
What is included in the starting price?

It depends on the service and confirmed quotation. Your proposal lists inclusions, exclusions and the pricing basis before booking. Road Trip and Signature starting prices are not per-person or complete-package prices.
Can you help with payments and travel preparation in China?
Journey Planning includes practical pre-trip guidance on payments, mobile connectivity and local transport. The exact support provided will be confirmed in your service proposal.
What happens if our plans change?
Cancellation and date-change rules vary by service and booking stage. Read the applicable service terms and any disclosed third-party charges before confirming your trip.
How do we get in touch during our journey?
Your confirmed travel documents explain your contact channel, support hours and what to do if you need help. Support depends on the service you book.
